About the Series

The soul remembers
before the mind understands.

The Two Souls Series is an emotional, ocean-soaked journey of recognition, longing, surrender, becoming, and love that does not end. It follows the invisible pull between souls who find each other across distance, timing, fear, and fate.

Six books. Six original song albums. One becoming.
